job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
job.acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Delaware Office of the State Treasurer RFP for deferred compensation plan recordkeeping and administration, not the LAFPP RFP for financial statement audit services. Its five-year initial term and three one-year extension options do not support the requested contract term.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR DEFERRED COMPENSATION PLAN RECORDKEEPING AND ADMINISTRATION SERVICES ISSUED BY THE OFFICE OF THE STATE TREASURER

The original term of the contract between the successful Vendor and the State shall be five (5) years, beginning date to be determined, with OST having three one-year extension options, each exercisable in OST’s sole discretion, subject only to necessary Board approval.
